title: Combinatorics of translations of meager and closed measure zero sets
summary: We study combinatorial properties of translations of meager and closed sets of measure zero. We discuss constellations of Borel conjectures for related classes of small sets and show that there are no uncountable null-additive sets in the Miller model. We also study cardinal invariants of those classes. In particular, we investigate the cardinal invariants of $σ$-ideals $\mathcal{H}_{F}$ related to meager-additive sets.
